enchantment.arcanavaria.eclipse.desc: 2 more damage a level against the undead at night, in total darkness, and always in the Nether and the End. Incompatible with Smite and Sharpness.
enchantment.arcanavaria.grim_harvest.des: Kills can grant Grim Harvest: 20% more speed and 20% less damage taken for 6, 9 or 12 seconds (30%, 50% or 70% chance).
enchantment.arcanavaria.reapers_step.des: Use to dash forward, hurting everything in your path (4, 6 or 8 damage). Costs one durability, recharges in 1.5 seconds and never breaks the scythe. With a shield in your off hand, sneak to dash.
enchantment.arcanavaria.soul_devourer.de: Killing a monster with the scythe can heal you 1, 2 or 3 hearts (40%, 60% or 80% chance, depending on the level).

research.arcanavaria.alembic_lattice.sta: Essentia in a tube is a soup: it drifts where the suction is. In glass, one measure at a time, it could be counted, timed and steered like a bead on a wire.

The lattice carries essentia as single motes that glow in their aspect's colour, one block every half second. An Intake set against a jar draws one mote each second; use it with an empty hand to change the pace, down to one mote per redstone pulse; otherwise a redstone signal stops it. An Outlet set against a jar fills it, and waits while the jar is full. Pipes carry a mote straight on where they can and take turns at forks. A mote with nowhere to go spills as flux.
research.arcanavaria.amberbark_lash.stag: The Warden moved its roots like a herdsman's whip. A lash of greatwood and amber might drive other things to fight for you.
The Amberbark Lash is a summoner's whip: it hits softly itself, but what it marks stays marked for 15 seconds and your summons strike it far harder. A cracking tip roots its target for a moment.
research.arcanavaria.architects_lens.sta: A builder's eye sees the same arch four times before it is laid once. A lens ground for Ordo could lay it four times too.

The Architect's Lens builds with Ordo vis from a carried wand and blocks from your inventory or a linked supply. Hold G for its mode wheel and open Settings to choose a shape, range, exchange options, blueprint rotation or mirror. Surface, column, row, grid, stairs and wall shapes build on the clicked face. Hold the building block in your other hand, or sneak-click one to select its state. Exchange returns the original material and spends Ordo and Perditio. Destroy spends Perditio to void an area. Its undo restores the blocks. Each block costs 5 centivis at range 1-5, 10 at 6-10, and 15 at 11-15. Choose Bind supply and click a chest face to draw from it within 64 blocks in this dimension. Copy still writes a selected box to a blank Blueprint Scroll. Paste uses a written scroll, including its configured rotation and mirror. Settings lists its missing materials in chat. Mirror and radial modes still copy blocks around their anchor. Sneak-scroll changes mode, and sneak-right-clicking air undoes up to 20 operations in this dimension until the world closes. Exchange undo takes back the original material before restoring it.
research.arcanavaria.elemental_scythe.st: The elemental blades carry the air's spite in their edge. A scythe so made would never stop reaping.
The Elemental Scythe is the heaviest and widest-sweeping of the three, and like the elemental sword its strikes arc to nearby foes.
research.arcanavaria.elemental_whip.stag: Six crystals braided into one cord: each lash would carry whichever primal answered first.
The Elemental Whip is the longest of the three. Every hit carries one primal: aer lifts, ignis burns, aqua drenches and slows, terra shoves, ordo marks with a glow, perditio withers.
research.arcanavaria.exanimator.stage_0: Death and darkness are two aspects that should never share a room. Burnt together in the old towers, they are said to wake something that was buried there on purpose.
research.arcanavaria.exanimator.stage_1: At night, inside a wizard tower, let a Thurible's Mortuus cloud and another's Tenebrae cloud touch. The Exanimator climbs out of the floor between them: a starved giant of bone and sinew with a void where its heart was. Its tentacles lash far, and when its ribs open the void drags everything toward it. Light is its weakness: a Lux cloud burns it and makes it reel. Wounded to half, it mends in the dark, burns in bright light and keeps you in Darkness, so carry light to it. It leaves behind its own blade, Exanimator's Edge, the finest scythe there is.
research.arcanavaria.exanimator.title: The Exanimator
research.arcanavaria.forsaken_laboratori: Whoever reads this has walked into one of our laboratories, and the ward has let them in. We built the wards to keep what we made inside. Every tower has a heart of void-glass at its root: while it burns, nothing sealed in leaves, nothing flies, nothing tears the walls. It falls only when the guardian at its altar dies.
research.arcanavaria.greatwood_warden.st: Old groves keep a guardian. Its heart is amber and its patience is long, but it can be woken.

Plant a Heartseed on open ground and the Greatwood Warden grows out of it. It slams the ground around it, sends roots erupting along the earth toward you (watch where the ground stirs), hurls splinters and burns a beam of amber light from its heart. Near leaves it kneels to mend itself: hit it hard while it does and it staggers. Wounded to half, it roars and fights faster, and learns to travel under the roots. Its living amber heart, once eaten, makes you a little harder to kill.
research.arcanavaria.intro.stage_0: Not every useful thing fits a school. These notes gather the odds and ends of your craft: tools, tricks and curiosities that belong nowhere else.
research.arcanavaria.intro.title: Arcana Varia
research.arcanavaria.lab_guardians.stage: We never made one thing twice. Every guardian came out of the altar wearing what the vats had poured into it: fire in one, a hunger for blood in the next, a body that would not stay dead. Read the bar over its head; it names everything the vats gave it. Strike it down and its altar gives back what it hoarded.
research.arcanavaria.lab_guardians.title: Notes on the Failed Experiments
research.arcanavaria.lab_lens.stage_0: The towers were not built by hand. The Lens copies a hall into a scroll and lays it down again elsewhere. I leave my best scrolls in the vaults for whoever comes after: a stair, an arch, a bench.
research.arcanavaria.lab_lens.title: The Architect's Diary
research.arcanavaria.lab_puzzles.stage_0: Our doors open for those who understand them. Aspect locks drink one essence only, poured from a phial, a censer or a lattice. Rune locks remember a sequence carved somewhere in the room. Sun lenses cast a beam that mirrors turn; give it to the crystal eye. The lifts breathe vis upwards and the phase stones keep time.
research.arcanavaria.lab_puzzles.title: Locks of the Thaumaturges
research.arcanavaria.lattice_junction.st: Two aspects meeting in the same instant should fall into their compound, as they do on the research table. In the lattice, the instant is the hard part.

A Junction joins two motes that reach its heart from different faces within eight ticks of each other, if the two make a compound; the compound leaves through the face it was placed facing. A mote left waiting longer spills as flux. Path length is delay: every block adds ten ticks. A Synchronizer holds one mote; synchronizers side by side and facing the same way let go together, only once every one of them holds a mote. Use one with an empty hand to add a delay; a redstone signal holds the whole row.
research.arcanavaria.lattice_prism.stage: What the junction joins, a prism of amethyst might part again, as a centrifuge does, but mote by mote.
A Splitter Prism takes motes in at its back. A compound splits into its two parents, one out of the left face and one out of the right; a primal passes on through the front.
research.arcanavaria.lattice_prism.title: Splitter Prism
research.arcanavaria.scythes.stage_0: A sword is for one foe. A long curved blade on a long haft could mow a crowd like wheat, if you can live with its weight.
research.arcanavaria.scythes.stage_1: The Thaumium Scythe swings slowly and hard (1.2 times a second), reaches a block further than a sword and sweeps through everything beside its target. It cuts leaves, crops and grass quickly. Scythes take their own enchantments: Soul Devourer, Grim Harvest and Eclipse at the enchanting table, Reaper's Step from treasure. Sweeping Edge does nothing for a blade that already sweeps.
research.arcanavaria.scythes.title: Scythes
research.arcanavaria.thurible.stage_0: Censers carry incense through a crowd on a chain. One that carried essentia instead would leave each aspect hanging in the air, working on whoever breathed it.
research.arcanavaria.thurible.stage_1: The Thurible holds up to 64 essentia of one aspect, shown through its glass. To fill it, right-click a jar with it, or hold a filled phial in your other hand and use the Thurible; sneak and right-click a jar to pour it back. Hold use to swing it: each swing leaves a cloud of the aspect in front of you, and a hit leaves one on the target. Its tooltip says what the loaded aspect does. Primal aspects each have their own effect; a compound with no effect of its own carries its parents' effects, stronger the more it was compounded, so lattice-made aspects are the strongest incense. Blueprints from old libraries fit a longer chain, a wider bowl or an orbit ring (sneak and use to set it circling you).
research.arcanavaria.thurible.title: The Thurible
research.arcanavaria.void_scythe.stage_0: Void metal hungers. A scythe of it might reap more than the living.
research.arcanavaria.void_scythe.stage_1: The Void Scythe hits harder and sweeps wider than the thaumium one, mends itself slowly while carried, and leaves what it strikes weakened. Like all void gear it weighs a little on the mind.
research.arcanavaria.void_scythe.title: Void Scythe
research.arcanavaria.void_whip.stage_0: Void metal drawn thin as wire still hungers. Bound into a lash it might take something back with every blow.
research.arcanavaria.void_whip.stage_1: The Void Whip reaches further and hits harder than the thaumium one. What it strikes is weakened, and a cracking tip drinks back a heart of life. Like all void gear it weighs a little on the mind.
research.arcanavaria.void_whip.title: Void Whip
research.arcanavaria.whips.stage_0: A blade only reaches as far as the arm. A cord of thaumium wire, thrown right, reaches five blocks and cracks at its tip like thunder.
research.arcanavaria.whips.stage_1: The Thaumium Whip lashes everything along its cord, hardest at the tip; a tip moving fast enough cracks for a critical hit. What it strikes is marked for your summons. Whips swing on Fundamentum's cord.
research.arcanavaria.whips.title: Whips

jei.arcanavaria.info.aspect_lock: Part of the Forsaken Laboratories and cannot be crafted or broken there. Wants essentia of the aspect its keyhole glows: pour it in from a phial, a Thurible, a lattice outlet or an essentia tube. Full, it opens and gives a redstone signal.
jei.arcanavaria.info.beam_emitter: Part of the Forsaken Laboratories and cannot be crafted or broken there. Throws a light beam up to 32 blocks along its face; it stops at anything solid.
jei.arcanavaria.info.beam_mirror: Part of the Forsaken Laboratories and cannot be crafted or broken there. Turns a light beam a quarter turn. Right-click to flip it between / and \.
jei.arcanavaria.info.beam_receptor: Part of the Forsaken Laboratories and cannot be crafted or broken there. Lights and gives a redstone signal when a light beam reaches it.
jei.arcanavaria.info.floor_gate: Part of the Forsaken Laboratories and cannot be crafted or broken there. A hatch over the tower stair that stays shut until the floor below is cleared.
jei.arcanavaria.info.guardian_altar: Part of the Forsaken Laboratories and cannot be crafted or broken there. Where a sealed tower's guardian waits. Killing it lifts the ward.
jei.arcanavaria.info.lab_journal: Found in Forsaken Laboratory chests and as a guardian's reward. Use it to learn the research it holds.
jei.arcanavaria.info.phase_block: Part of the Forsaken Laboratories and cannot be crafted or broken there. Solid for two seconds out of four, a ghost you fall through for the rest. A redstone signal holds it solid.
jei.arcanavaria.info.rune_lock: Part of the Forsaken Laboratories and cannot be crafted or broken there. Opens when its rune stones are pressed in the right order (the clue is in the room), then gives a redstone signal.
jei.arcanavaria.info.rune_stone: Part of the Forsaken Laboratories and cannot be crafted or broken there. Press it to tell the rune locks within 12 blocks its glyph.
jei.arcanavaria.info.vis_lift: Part of the Forsaken Laboratories and cannot be crafted or broken there. A column of rising motes up to 16 blocks high that carries you up; sneak to sink.
jei.arcanavaria.info.ward_core: Part of the Forsaken Laboratories and cannot be crafted or broken there. The heart of a sealed tower: step inside and nobody can leave until its guardian dies.
jei.arcanavaria.info.warden_amber_heart: Dropped by the Greatwood Warden. Use it for 2 more hearts of max health, once per player.
